decision.expected_benefit_hypothesis: Averaging two independent 16-sample estimates (approx. halving variance, reducing SD by ~1/sqrt(2)) should reduce stochastic misranking, produce more reliable selection/elites, and speed convergence toward higher true expected robust performance.
